`python3 main.py` now exits cleanly and prints `Total: 5.0`.

`settings.json` had a typo: the key was `"rat"` instead of `"rate"`. `pricing.get_rate()` looks up `"rate"`, so it got `None`, which caused the `TypeError` in `compute_total`. I renamed the key to `"rate"` and changed nothing else.
